# RevDale Practice Solutions

> RevDale Practice Solutions is a medical billing and credentialing company for private practices. We provide medical billing, revenue cycle management, provider credentialing and contracting, medical billing audits, system setup, and front desk support. We currently support 85+ providers across 18 specialties, with a first-time claims acceptance rate above 95%.

## Services
- [Medical billing services for private practices](https://revdalepracticesolutions.com/medical-billing/): Medical billing for private practices: eligibility checks, clean claims, denial appeals, A/R follow-up, and clear reports. Request a free practice audit.
- [Provider credentialing and payer enrollment](https://revdalepracticesolutions.com/credentialing/): Provider credentialing, payer enrollment, and contracting for private practices: government and commercial payers, CAQH, revalidations, ERA and EFT setup.

## Guides
- [How to choose a medical billing company](https://revdalepracticesolutions.com/resources/how-to-choose-a-medical-billing-company/): A practical guide to choosing a medical billing company: what to ask, how to compare fee structures, contract terms to check, and red flags to avoid.
- [What does medical billing cost?](https://revdalepracticesolutions.com/resources/medical-billing-cost/): How medical billing companies charge: percentage of collections, flat fees, and per-claim pricing, plus fees to watch for and how to compare quotes fairly.
- [Why medical claims get denied (and how to prevent it)](https://revdalepracticesolutions.com/resources/why-claims-get-denied/): The most common reasons medical claims are denied or rejected, what denial codes mean, and a practical checklist to prevent denials and recover revenue.
